notes: Main SERL pipeline under the main protocol: at most 7 Doctor-Agent collaboration turns with early stopping (configs/effectiveness/v8_agentclinic_max7.json) on the frozen dataset version agentclinic_main_v2. Every Agent turn that a collaboration reached is a GRPO completion sample and is rewarded for its own turn: R_t = 0.4 R_O + 0.3 R_A,t + 0.3 R_E,t. This protocol has no Effectiveness predictor yet (reward.effectiveness.stages is empty), so R_E is unavailable at every turn and GRPO training with w_E > 0 does not start; the end-to-end check runs without it. The fixed two-turn configuration (serl_agentclinic.json) and its Effectiveness v1 are the earlier protocol's and are not used here.

data.notes: the case-level split of the frozen dataset version agentclinic_main_v2 in the format of src/data/split.py (derived from data/splits/agentclinic_main_v2.json; TEST is that format's eval). The rubric step analyses TRAIN failures only by it, and predictor training checks its labels against it.

collaboration.notes: One collaboration turn is one Doctor -> Agent pair. After every Agent turn before the seventh the Doctor finalizes or continues; after A7 the final diagnosis is mandatory.
collaboration.max_rounds_status: decided 2026-10-02: max 7 collaboration turns with early stopping is the main protocol

environment.notes: Dataset version (agentclinic_main_v2: TRAIN 90 / DEV 31 / TEST 60), protocol, models, decoding and prompts come from the max-7 run's config. histories are that run's D1 histories. base_trajectories are the base Agent's collaborations under this protocol with their Agent-side states: iteration 0 takes its TRAIN rows as they are.

training_samples.notes: One completion sample per Agent turn that a collaboration reached. A collaboration that stopped after A3 gives A1, A2 and A3 samples; A4-A7 samples are not made up.

effectiveness.notes: No Effectiveness predictor exists for this protocol yet. It will be ONE turn-conditioned predictor (intervention_turn A1 ... A7) trained on labels of this protocol at every reached turn; Effectiveness v1 and the two-turn labels are not used. Until it exists and passes its DEV evaluation, R_E is unavailable at every turn (never 0), the other weights are not rescaled, and GRPO training with w_E > 0 does not start.

rubric_registry.initial_rubrics_notes: null: iteration 0 builds its rubrics from the base failures. A path <run>/iter0/rubrics: iteration 0 takes that run's rubric step as it is (same base collaborations), so that the conditions of one experiment share R_0 and the same raw candidates (INITIAL_RUBRICS with scripts/run_serl.sh).
rubric_registry.max_active_categories_status: not used: the number of rubrics is whatever passes validation, consolidation and the effectiveness-gap filter

selection.min_group_n_status: OPEN DECISION: no minimum-support rule existed. Implemented: both adherence groups need at least one response with an Effectiveness value; otherwise the rubric is removed as insufficient_support (its gap is not set to 0). A larger minimum must be chosen without looking at DEV or TEST.
selection.population_status: OPEN DECISION: which scored responses the gap is computed from. Implemented: every Agent turn of the current policy's valid TRAIN collaborations (the file the iteration's failures come from), scored against the consolidated rubrics, with the frozen predictor's Effectiveness.
selection.engineering_safety_cap_status: OPEN DECISION: no cap is applied. A cap for cost reasons would be separate from the method and is not implemented.

rubric_registry.notes: Main method, per iteration and from that iteration's failures only: candidate generation -> validation rerun -> consolidation (one canonical rubric per category) -> effectiveness gap of each rubric = mean Effectiveness of the responses scored 2 minus mean Effectiveness of the responses scored 0 (score 1 is in neither group) -> rubrics with a positive gap form the set, weight = gap; a non-positive gap or an empty group removes the rubric. No negative weight exists. Nothing is carried over: no registry of earlier iterations is read, nothing is reactivated, and there is no cap. Each iteration's candidates, validations, assignments, table (rubric_table.json) and set are kept as its record. schedule fixed (Static): the set named by fixed_rubric_set is used unchanged in every iteration. schedule no_filtering: every raw candidate so far, cumulative, weight 1 each.

scorer.max_rubrics_per_call_notes: null: all rubrics of the active set in one scorer call (at most max_active_categories). A number: a response scored against more rubrics is sent in several calls of that many rubrics.

rubric_manager.retention_policy_notes: every iteration writes its rubrics from its own candidates; no rubric of an earlier iteration is reused or reactivated

rubric_importance.notes: The weight of a rubric is its effectiveness gap (rubric_registry.selection); the Weighted SoftMin normalizes the weights of the rubrics applicable to a response. Failure frequency (generation count) is stored for analysis and is not a weight.
